entries.title: This website begins
entries.note: thanks2all.org is my public thank-you note. Every school, teacher, friend, colleague, and mentor who shaped my path has a place here. I will add a short diary line whenever I want to say thank you again.

entries.title: A new chapter in Singapore
entries.note: I joined Persol to support OCBC database services. Eighteen years after MCA, the work still teaches me — and I am grateful for every team that trusted me with production systems.

entries.title: MCA, Osmania University
entries.note: Hyderabad and Osmania University changed my life. The decision to stay with computers after B.Sc. opened every door that followed.

entries.title: B.Sc. Computer Science, Tirupati
entries.note: SV Arts College and Sri Venkateswara University gave me the first real map of computing. I still thank those classrooms.

entries.title: From Bapababana to Damal Cheruvu
entries.note: Bapababana until 2nd class. Kazi Patasala in Chittoor. A short season at Vadhappa Naidu High School. Then ZP High School, Damal Cheruvu, where I finished school. Those rooms were the start.
